⚙ What I'm Working On

I'm currently working on a UI/UX redesign of XploreJogja.com — a tourism website — using Figma to craft a more intuitive and visually engaging experience for users. I'm also involved in QA testing using Postman for API validation, documenting findings through Spreadsheet and Odoo, and building web projects using Laravel.

🎯 What I'm Trying to Achieve

I'm aiming to bridge the gap between good design and reliable software quality — ensuring that digital products are not only visually appealing but also functional and well-tested.
